independent.method: 76 exact-source schema/redaction assertions, pending-call mutation controls, actual offline Supabase SDK serialization, numeric snapshot/audit and compaction probes; independently adjudicated all Gemini findings.

findings: Pending-record newline finalization ignores the actual bytesWritten result; injected zero-progress return can permit concatenated records on the following append
resolution: Candidate requires exactly one byte reported before sync/finalization; actual production-path fault test preserves ledger and manifest, proves no success sync and a closed handle, then restores real I/O and proves successful finalization/reopen/monotonic append. Full candidate root run passes600 tests with one intended live skip. Renewed exact-head reviews required.

gemini_dispositions.finding: RPC full guard should be inert-only
gemini_dispositions.basis: RPC sends the entire message and has no local Zod stripping stage. Full retained-metadata validation before the detached copy prevents nonfinite/undefined values entering the serialized wire payload. Independent actual SDK probes confirm this boundary.

gemini_dispositions.finding: Unknown literal/current version should be unsupported_schema
gemini_dispositions.basis: Unknown literal with current version1 is malformed current data. Genuine future numeric version2 is unsupported with both old/new literals, as frozen tests prove. Chronology is not inferred from arbitrary strings.

Independent exact-method/API zero-progress fault probe demonstrates false finalization. Official Node24 API reports actual bytesWritten. This is controlled fault injection, not spontaneous zero-write reproduction on this host.

suggestions_disposition.local_inbox_depth: Non-blocking conservative full-state depth check can reject deeply nested historical inbox messages; bytes remain intact. COORD owns bounded inbox/query behavior and integration; documented traversal limits are retained.
suggestions_disposition.encoded_nonfinite_text: Non-blocking conservative decoded-JSON scanning treats overflowing numeric text as unsafe despite string round-trip; existing tightened historical metadata policy fails closed without mutation. No transparent historical content migration claimed.
suggestions_disposition.evidence_store_field_reads: Pre-existing helper repeated reads can bypass its smaller configurable excerpt threshold, but final common evidence schema still bounds and validates persisted values. Follow-up; no EC falsified by reviewed probes.
suggestions_disposition.rpc_list_aliases: Read-query alias hardening remains COORD-owned RPC semantics, outside DATA durable-write boundary.
suggestions_disposition.derived_schemas: Documented caller guard requirement remains; concrete APIs preserved, arbitrary derived/outer root inspection is not claimed guarded.
suggestions_disposition.coordination_private_json: Pre-existing COORD-owned lease/cooldown JSON emission before ledger validation retained as downstream boundary work.
suggestions_disposition.nested_append_regression: Non-blocking additional regression suggestion; recursive post-await guard already covers nested aliases and completed Opus independently reproduced them.
